subject: general
question: In Which state of India experiences winter rainfall due to retreating monsoon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu** experiences winter rainfall due to the retreating monsoon.
 
• The retreating monsoon, also known as the northeast monsoon, occurs when the monsoon winds reverse direction and blow from the northeast to the southwest.
 
• This phenomenon typically happens during the months of October to December.
 
• During this period, Tamil Nadu and parts of Andhra Pradesh receive significant rainfall.
 
• This rainfall is crucial for the agricultural activities in these regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The retreating monsoon is influenced by the shifting of the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) towards the south.
 
• During the southwest monsoon, the ITCZ is positioned over the Indian subcontinent, bringing heavy rainfall to the region.
 
• As the ITCZ moves southwards, the southwest monsoon winds weaken, and the northeast monsoon winds begin to dominate.
 
• These winds pick up moisture from the Bay of Bengal and bring rainfall to the southeastern coast of India.
 
• The northeast monsoon is relatively less intense compared to the southwest monsoon but is vital for the water resources in Tamil Nadu.
